operatorProperties.code:
def process(worldcities) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = worldcities.copy()
    # National capitals are marked as 'primary' in this dataset
    df = df[df["capital"].astype("string").str.lower() == "primary"].copy()

    df["population"] = pd.to_numeric(df["population"], errors="coerce")
    df["lat"] = pd.to_numeric(df["lat"], errors="coerce")

    # If a country has multiple primary capitals, keep the one with the largest population
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["country", "population", "lat", "city"],
        ascending=[True, False, False, True],
        na_position="last",
    )
    topCapitals = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["country"], keep="first")

    avgLat = topCapitals["lat"].mean()
    return pd.DataFrame([{"avg_latitude": round(float(avgLat), 4)}])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute average latitude of national capital cities from worldcities: filter rows where capital == 'primary' (case-insensitive); coerce 'population' and 'lat' to numeric; within each country sort by population desc (tie-break by lat desc then city asc) and keep the top row; compute mean latitude across selected capitals; round to 4 decimals; output single-row DataFrame with column avg_latitude.
